messages.content: I’m building the day-ahead book around the evening price peak, with down-regulation revenue helping replenish the battery and up reserves limited to available battery and meter headroom. I’ll check feasibility before committing, then manage the book through the day.

Down-regulation charging has been lighter than forecast, so I reduced the morning discharge. I’m now adding afternoon charging to restore backing for the fixed reserve awards and evening energy sales.
